title: Cross-functional launch sprint conductor for Private Deployments (RBAC/Audit/KMS)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run the cross-functional launch sprint that coordinates release notes, compliance signoffs, enablement assets, and staged rollout for Private/VPC/on-prem features: RBAC roles, audit logging pipeline, and KMS integration. This ticket is the conductor — it sequences stakeholder reviews, validates migration guidance, and verifies end-to-end customer enablement before wave 1 activation.
objectives: Ship RBAC role matrix and migration instructions for existing customers
Publish final release notes and localized summaries for EU and NA customers
Deliver operator runbook for audit log collection, retention, and alerting
Complete KMS integration checklist and customer-facing key rotation guidance
Coordinate signoffs from Security, Legal, and Support to unblock GA
success_metrics: < 2 high-severity support tickets in first 72 hours after wave 1
> 80% of enterprise pilot customers complete self-serve enablement flow
Release notes opened by > 60% of active private deployments in pilot cohort
Telemetry shows no degradation in auth/authorization error rate post-rollback window
timeline_summary: 2025-02-14: Draft release notes and RBAC migration doc ready (done)
2025-02-24: Release candidate build and internal dry-run
2025-03-07: GA candidate and public release notes publish
launch_waves: Wave 0 - internal operator teams and vendor partners (smoke test, non-customer-facing)
Wave 1 - select pilot customers (manual enable, close support channel)
Wave 2 - extended beta customers via opt-in toggle
Wave 3 - full GA rollout with self-serve enablement and docs
rollout_criteria: No P0 security findings from review groups
Audit log ingestion validated for schema and retention in two regions
KMS integration passes key creation, encryption/decryption, and rotation tests
Operator runbook validated in dry-run and support playbook rehearsed
Release notes and migration doc published and acknowledged by Sales/AMs
release_notes_outline: Short summary for admins: what changed and why
Technical details: API changes, endpoints, config keys
Migration steps: role mapping, example CLI commands, rollback steps
Security & compliance section: audit log format, retention defaults, KMS behavior
Impact & troubleshooting: common errors and quick fixes
Localization: TL;DR snippets for EU/NA support pages
enablement_assets: Slide deck for Sales & AMs: PrivateDeploy_OperatorDeck_v3.pptx
Support playbook and triage flow chart (doc link)
Video walkthrough for pilot customers - link will be uploaded to enablement folder
comms_plan: Internal announcement: 48 hours before Wave 0 to infra and support teams
Pilot customer email: targeted messaging with enablement steps and support hours
Public release notes publish at GA with short-form blog and changelog entry
Changelog entry to include explicit migration checklist and link to SDK compatibility notes
Post-GA follow-up to pilots collecting feedback and issues report
go_to_market_tasks: Finalize pricing/packaging language for Dedicated vs Private tiers
Create customer-facing FAQ for RBAC and KMS tradeoffs
Prepare AM cheat-sheet with upgrade/migration talking points
Update platform status and SLA docs to reflect audit log guarantees
Coordinate with marketplace partners for private deployment listings
training_plan: 1-hour enablement session for Sales and AMs focusing on objections and migration paths
Office hours schedule for first two weeks post-wave 1
Hands-on lab exercise for customers to validate RBAC role mappings
risk_register: Risk: Customers misconfigure RBAC and lock out service accounts
Risk: Audit pipeline incompatible with customer SIEM schemas
Risk: KMS key policy differences across clouds cause unexpectedly failed encrypt ops
Risk: Documentation ambiguity leads to rollout delays for EU customers
mitigation_actions: Provide pre-flight RBAC validator script and sample role JSON
Ship audit schema adapter examples for three common SIEMs and sample ingest pipeline
Create cloud-specific KMS Key Policy templates and tested examples
Localize critical docs and pin a dedicated translator for compliance wording
telemetry_and_slo: Dashboards: per-tenant RBAC failures and audit volume by region
Alert thresholds: auth_denied_rate > 0.5% sustained triggers P1 investigation
SLO window: monitor first 14 days after activation for deviations
qa_and_validation: End-to-end test harness with simulated tenant migrations
Backwards-compatibility tests for SDKs and CLI
Manual exploratory for audit log edge cases and retention expiry
KMS rotation smoke tests with recovery scenarios
post_launch_followups: 72-hour post-activation ticket review and RCA for high-severity issues
Two-week usage review to measure enablement completion rates
Update release notes with known issues and workarounds after wave 1
Schedule retrospective with Engineering, Product, Security, and Support
notes: 2025-02-14 - Drafted migration examples for common role-to-permission mappings
2025-02-16 - Security requested additional KMS key policy templates for GCP and Azure
2025-02-18 - Support confirmed readiness for Wave 0 and scheduled dry-run
